whole_lifetime_hazard_reviews.candidate_required_control: Bind the actual stable target guard/open description and all lock object/ancestor/mount/FD aliases;keep it distinct from reference FD9 and not child-unlockable. Source open/acquire order alone is not continuous exclusion or known release.

Enumerate original inherited FDs,process substitutions,pipelines,all descendants/streams and in-flight writers across their complete lifetime. Requests to stop or parent exit do not prove drained effects.

Independently bind both original canonical and compatibility package-database routes,all directory entries/objects and aliases through capture,backend use,restoration and target evidence. A filename listing is no exclusion interval.

Protect exact actual source/archive/interpreter/dependency bytes and all checked-to-used object/alias routes through every consumption. Separate path/hash opens are not an independently proven continuous native fence.

Treat generator input check,later reopen/read/encoding,temporary creation,syntax check and final output as one complete protected-consumption review. Inert historical generator remains unexecuted;generated syntax proves no rights or lifetime.

Bind every individually owned intent/name/parent/rename/hardlink/mount/open-handle alias;do not use broad subtree exclusions or path flags to assume cleanup rights. Foreign or uncertain ownership blocks dependent cleanup.
Retain dry-run/check output/log/transport/child effects as in-scope questions. Operation name or module flag cannot establish no effects or privilege/trust exemption.

Retain original forbidden GenInitrd-policy effects;independently establish no reachable outside-scope mutation. Fingerprint/copy/replace/restore path checks and owned flags prove no exact object continuity or durable recovery.

Retain original forbidden boot/GRUB output mutations. Full actual ancestors/temp/destination/rename/backing routes require independent classification;stat/checksum/source rename sites are not continuous identity or no-replace durability proof.

Keep original memory baseline,known exact protected backup,owned binding and target state separate. Unknown owned backup/commit cannot prove unchanged target or authorize restore;finite known recovery preconditions remain.

Review service own first writes and every worker first effect before trap/guard/capture barriers. Preserve traps-first and guard/freshoriginal-before-owned-write order;historical preparations before traps cannot be reused as compatible entry.

Signal/trap delivery,reentrancy,ignored cleanup errors,full children and original sticky status remain separately reviewed. Cleanup outcome never converts original failure to success or grants repeat rights.

Keep every backend hook/helper/rollback descendant and inherited writer route inside full effect/scope review. Namespace/postinst flags do not prove complete control;restore is its own once-only finite authorized action,not repeat backend dispatch.

Only independently known full original restoration/invariants/target evidence and all-child/FD/stream/in-flight drain permit target release. Snapshot/flag/status counts are not closure;guard loss never permits reacquisition or new grant.

Publish captured closed data only,under separate publication controls. No late target/source reads,automatic unknown-backup deletion or borrowed target rights after release. Preserve owned/controller/publication pending outcomes.

Archive,sidecar,receipt commit,independent final observation and custody have separate writer/source/rights/storage outcomes. No atomic pair,self-final receipt or passive observer exemption;whole current stage12 remains normative pending405/407 migration.

expected_statements.guard_lifetime: DRAFT joint retention requirement: establish service/ledger controls before their own first effects;worker traps before worker effects;stable distinct target guard and fresh original in-memory capture before transaction-owned writes;known exact backups before target mutation. Guard owner loss/replacement/contention/unknown never authorizes force unlock, unlink/recreate, reacquire, rebind, renewed rights or presumed child drain.
